name: Leonidas Code
releaseDefinition: A dependable people-and-agents workspace: capture and plan tasks, explicitly delegate work, coordinate shared projects, connect remotely, and recover data across supported desktop, web and mobile clients. V1.0 requires a verified release candidate and explicit approval from Jake and Mob. Leonidas Scribe and the broader Leonidas app are separate release scopes.

milestones.title: Daily planning
milestones.goal: A person can capture, schedule, complete and trace work to a release.

tasks.title: Finish daily task workflows on all entry points
tasks.description:
## Goal
Exercise capture, due set/clear, Today/Upcoming, complete/reopen and project switching. Share derived date logic between clients; preserve imported cards.

## Start files
apps/web/src/components/taskBoard; apps/mobile task navigation; packages/client-runtime

## Dependencies
V0.21 planning baseline.

## Done when
- [ ] Focused daily-task tests pass; desktop and narrow web verified; native mobile proof recorded.
- [ ] Report changed files, scoped checks and remaining limitations; preserve unrelated work.

## Verification
Focused daily-task tests pass; desktop and narrow web verified; native mobile proof recorded.

Roadmap key: daily-task-parity

tasks.title: Make release planning editable and shareable
tasks.description:
## Goal
Persist milestone assignments, expose them to agents, and support editing project-roadmap.json without losing existing task progress. Verify collaborators see the same assignments.

## Start files
apps/web/src/components/taskBoard; apps/server/src/taskBoard; packages/contracts/src/taskBoard.ts

## Dependencies
V0.21 planning baseline.

## Done when
- [ ] Create, move, clear and reload a milestone task; shared records round trip; malformed plans leave tasks usable.
- [ ] Report changed files, scoped checks and remaining limitations; preserve unrelated work.

## Verification
Create, move, clear and reload a milestone task; shared records round trip; malformed plans leave tasks usable.

Roadmap key: release-planning

milestones.title: Agent execution
milestones.goal: Delegation is explicit, recoverable and returns truthful progress to tasks.

tasks.title: Persist the task-to-agent execution lifecycle
tasks.description:
## Goal
Connect task IDs to thread and turn receipts. Keep progress, failure and completion summaries durable; a failed or cancelled turn must not mark its task done.

## Start files
apps/web/src/components/taskBoard/useTaskActions.ts; apps/server/src/taskBoard; apps/server/src/orchestration-v2

## Dependencies
Complete the V0.22.0 release gate before accepting this milestone.

## Done when
- [ ] Focused success/failure/cancel/reconnect tests; one isolated explicit delegation demonstrated with no duplicate thread.
- [ ] Report changed files, scoped checks and remaining limitations; preserve unrelated work.

## Verification
Focused success/failure/cancel/reconnect tests; one isolated explicit delegation demonstrated with no duplicate thread.

Roadmap key: agent-task-lifecycle

tasks.title: Add cancellation and retry to delegated tasks
tasks.description:
## Goal
Expose running work, stop and explicit retry using existing orchestration services. Retrying must retain history and prevent simultaneous duplicate work.

## Start files
apps/web task detail; packages/client-runtime; apps/server/src/orchestration-v2

## Dependencies
Complete the V0.22.0 release gate before accepting this milestone.

## Done when
- [ ] Stop/retry and stale connection tests pass; all installed provider adapters have a documented supported or unsupported outcome.
- [ ] Report changed files, scoped checks and remaining limitations; preserve unrelated work.

## Verification
Stop/retry and stale connection tests pass; all installed provider adapters have a documented supported or unsupported outcome.

Roadmap key: execution-controls

milestones.title: Team projects
milestones.goal: Jake and Mob can coordinate ownership and shared work without overwrites.

tasks.title: Prevent shared task edits from overwriting teammates
tasks.description:
## Goal
Use the existing GitHub shared board and compare stored revisions before overwriting. Surface conflicts with reload/retry and preserve task history.

## Start files
apps/server/src/taskBoard/TaskBoardService.ts; apps/server/src/taskBoard tests

## Dependencies
Complete the V0.23.0 release gate before accepting this milestone.

## Done when
- [ ] Two concurrent claim/edit scenarios tested; conflict produces recoverable feedback; remote changes remain intact.
- [ ] Report changed files, scoped checks and remaining limitations; preserve unrelated work.

## Verification
Two concurrent claim/edit scenarios tested; conflict produces recoverable feedback; remote changes remain intact.

Roadmap key: shared-concurrency

tasks.title: Show team ownership and shared project activity
tasks.description:
## Goal
Add readable shared activity, ownership and pending publication states. Explain project sharing setup and permission failures in place.

## Start files
apps/web/src/components/taskBoard; apps/mobile task views

## Dependencies
Complete the V0.23.0 release gate before accepting this milestone.

## Done when
- [ ] Two-member isolated fixture covers claim/release, publication failure and refresh; no false synced labels.
- [ ] Report changed files, scoped checks and remaining limitations; preserve unrelated work.

## Verification
Two-member isolated fixture covers claim/release, publication failure and refresh; no false synced labels.

Roadmap key: team-visibility

milestones.title: Remote continuity
milestones.goal: The same workspace works through local, remote and tunnel connections.

tasks.title: Recover task state after disconnects
tasks.description:
## Goal
Refresh authoritative tasks after reconnection, preserve unsaved capture text and avoid duplicate submissions. Keep destination permission checks in the existing command layer.

## Start files
packages/client-runtime connection and RPC; apps/web/src/components/taskBoard/useTaskBoard.ts

## Dependencies
Complete the V0.24.0 release gate before accepting this milestone.

## Done when
- [ ] Focused disconnect/reconnect and duplicate-submit tests across direct and relay transport fixtures.
- [ ] Report changed files, scoped checks and remaining limitations; preserve unrelated work.

## Verification
Focused disconnect/reconnect and duplicate-submit tests across direct and relay transport fixtures.

Roadmap key: remote-task-recovery

tasks.title: Make development preview and remote pairing dependable
tasks.description:
## Goal
Show healthy dev server URLs in Browser, recover expired pairing tokens and distinguish source version from installed release. Preserve isolated test state.

## Start files
apps/web/src/components/preview; scripts/dev-runner.ts; apps/server/src/auth

## Dependencies
Complete the V0.24.0 release gate before accepting this milestone.

## Done when
- [ ] Start isolated dev app, open Browser, pair, reconnect and observe source changes; user can repeat from instructions.
- [ ] Report changed files, scoped checks and remaining limitations; preserve unrelated work.

## Verification
Start isolated dev app, open Browser, pair, reconnect and observe source changes; user can repeat from instructions.

Roadmap key: pairing-preview

milestones.title: Every surface
milestones.goal: Core task and agent controls work on supported desktop, web and mobile clients.

tasks.title: Ship native mobile task planning and delegation
tasks.description:
## Goal
Implement Inbox/Today/Upcoming/projects, milestone display, detail edits and explicit delegation with shared contracts. Reuse permissions and reconnect behavior.

## Start files
apps/mobile navigation/screens; packages/client-runtime

## Dependencies
Complete the V0.25.0 release gate before accepting this milestone.

## Done when
- [ ] iOS and Android integrated task flows verified against isolated state; offline failures retain input.
- [ ] Report changed files, scoped checks and remaining limitations; preserve unrelated work.

## Verification
iOS and Android integrated task flows verified against isolated state; offline failures retain input.

Roadmap key: mobile-task-workflow

tasks.title: Close desktop and web navigation gaps
tasks.description:
## Goal
Make Tasks and Roadmap reachable through navigation and applicable command palette/keybindings. Verify desktop packaging and browser deep links.

## Start files
apps/web command palette/settings/keybindings; apps/desktop shell

## Dependencies
Complete the V0.25.0 release gate before accepting this milestone.

## Done when
- [ ] Entry-point checks pass; Electron and remote web open the same project task and milestone without stale selection.
- [ ] Report changed files, scoped checks and remaining limitations; preserve unrelated work.

## Verification
Entry-point checks pass; Electron and remote web open the same project task and milestone without stale selection.

Roadmap key: surface-parity

milestones.title: Data confidence
milestones.goal: Task and conversation data survives crashes, upgrades and operator mistakes.

tasks.title: Add verified task and workspace backup recovery
tasks.description:
## Goal
Implement export and restore through services with read-only preview, explicit confirmation and preservation of current data. Include native and imported task provenance.

## Start files
apps/server persistence services; taskBoard card storage; docs/user

## Dependencies
Complete the V0.26.0 release gate before accepting this milestone.

## Done when
- [ ] Round-trip isolated fixtures with Unicode paths and history; interruption leaves previous data readable; restore cannot escape its destination.
- [ ] Report changed files, scoped checks and remaining limitations; preserve unrelated work.

## Verification
Round-trip isolated fixtures with Unicode paths and history; interruption leaves previous data readable; restore cannot escape its destination.

Roadmap key: backup-restore

tasks.title: Prove safe upgrades from existing Leonidas installs
tasks.description:
## Goal
Add versioned migration fixtures for current/legacy state, preserve app identity and test rollback/recovery on an isolated copy.

## Start files
apps/desktop/src/updates; scripts/leonidas-release.ts; apps/server migrations

## Dependencies
Complete the V0.26.0 release gate before accepting this milestone.

## Done when
- [ ] Upgrade and failed-migration recovery evidence; no live userdata writes; installer and update metadata identify the same source commit.
- [ ] Report changed files, scoped checks and remaining limitations; preserve unrelated work.

## Verification
Upgrade and failed-migration recovery evidence; no live userdata writes; installer and update metadata identify the same source commit.

Roadmap key: upgrade-migration

milestones.title: First successful session
milestones.goal: A new user can connect an agent and finish a real task without assistance.

tasks.title: Simplify setup into one successful task
tasks.description:
## Goal
Build a guided path: connect a supported account, add a workspace, capture a task and explicitly start it. Offer recovery for missing runtimes and unsupported permissions.

## Start files
apps/web onboarding; provider connection settings; taskBoard

## Dependencies
Complete the V0.27.0 release gate before accepting this milestone.

## Done when
- [ ] Fresh-profile walkthrough reaches completed task; failed account/runtime setup has a working recovery path.
- [ ] Report changed files, scoped checks and remaining limitations; preserve unrelated work.

## Verification
Fresh-profile walkthrough reaches completed task; failed account/runtime setup has a working recovery path.

Roadmap key: onboarding-path

tasks.title: Document people, agents and project sharing workflows
tasks.description:
## Goal
Write concise guides for daily tasks, roadmap assignment, team sharing, remote access and recovery. Add contextual tours to actual controls.

## Start files
docs/user; apps/web/features/tour

## Dependencies
Complete the V0.27.0 release gate before accepting this milestone.

## Done when
- [ ] Each guide followed in isolated app; links and tour targets work; no internal contributor commands in product guidance.
- [ ] Report changed files, scoped checks and remaining limitations; preserve unrelated work.

## Verification
Each guide followed in isolated app; links and tour targets work; no internal contributor commands in product guidance.

Roadmap key: user-guides

milestones.title: Quality floor
milestones.goal: Busy workspaces stay responsive, accessible and truthful.

tasks.title: Measure and fix task views under realistic load
tasks.description:
## Goal
Profile thousands of cards, shared refresh and large descriptions. Remove unnecessary renders/reads; use existing virtualization patterns where measurement warrants it.

## Start files
apps/web/src/components/taskBoard; apps/server/taskBoard card reader

## Dependencies
Complete the V0.28.0 release gate before accepting this milestone.

## Done when
- [ ] Record before/after CPU, render and RPC measurements; no continuous repaint animation; large fixture remains interactive.
- [ ] Report changed files, scoped checks and remaining limitations; preserve unrelated work.

## Verification
Record before/after CPU, render and RPC measurements; no continuous repaint animation; large fixture remains interactive.

Roadmap key: task-performance

tasks.title: Complete keyboard and screen-reader task flows
tasks.description:
## Goal
Audit focus order, dialog recovery, milestone semantics, contrast, labels and target sizes. Fix failures without duplicating generic UI styles.

## Start files
apps/web taskBoard and UI components; apps/mobile task views

## Dependencies
Complete the V0.28.0 release gate before accepting this milestone.

## Done when
- [ ] Keyboard capture/edit/complete/roadmap flows and screen-reader announcements verified; WCAG 2.2 AA findings closed for scoped screens.
- [ ] Report changed files, scoped checks and remaining limitations; preserve unrelated work.

## Verification
Keyboard capture/edit/complete/roadmap flows and screen-reader announcements verified; WCAG 2.2 AA findings closed for scoped screens.

Roadmap key: accessibility-pass

milestones.title: Release candidate
milestones.goal: The launch candidate passes an integrated acceptance matrix.

tasks.title: Run the supported release acceptance matrix
tasks.description:
## Goal
Test supported provider/account paths, daily tasks, delegation, sharing, direct/remote access and recovery on packaged builds. Record defects as tasks; fix release blockers.

## Start files
apps/server provider adapters; apps/web; apps/desktop; apps/mobile; release tooling

## Dependencies
Complete the V0.29.0 release gate before accepting this milestone.

## Done when
- [ ] Evidence per supported surface/provider/connection mode; no unresolved blocker; limitations visible before launch.
- [ ] Report changed files, scoped checks and remaining limitations; preserve unrelated work.

## Verification
Evidence per supported surface/provider/connection mode; no unresolved blocker; limitations visible before launch.

Roadmap key: release-candidate

tasks.title: Prepare distributable builds and support recovery
tasks.description:
## Goal
Prepare installer/update artifacts, licenses, user help, diagnostics export and recovery guidance. Coordinate workflow changes with maintainers; do not publish.

## Start files
apps/desktop packaging; .github/workflows/team-release.yml; docs/user

## Dependencies
Complete the V0.29.0 release gate before accepting this milestone.

## Done when
- [ ] Artifacts locally validated, source provenance consistent, upgrade rehearsal successful, support guide follows observed behavior.
- [ ] Report changed files, scoped checks and remaining limitations; preserve unrelated work.

## Verification
Artifacts locally validated, source provenance consistent, upgrade rehearsal successful, support guide follows observed behavior.

Roadmap key: distribution-readiness

milestones.title: Public launch
milestones.goal: Ship only after owners accept the release candidate and approve public launch.

tasks.title: Resolve launch acceptance and obtain owner sign-off
tasks.description:
## Goal
Summarize candidate evidence and remaining limitations for Jake and Mob. Require explicit approval for public launch; milestone completion alone cannot publish.

## Start files
project-roadmap.json; release acceptance evidence; leonidas-release.json

## Dependencies
Complete the V0.30.0 release gate before accepting this milestone.

## Done when
- [ ] Owner approval recorded; every release-blocking task done; deferred scope and known limitations stated.
- [ ] Report changed files, scoped checks and remaining limitations; preserve unrelated work.

## Verification
Owner approval recorded; every release-blocking task done; deferred scope and known limitations stated.

Roadmap key: launch-signoff

tasks.title: Publish V1.0 and verify delivery
tasks.description:
## Goal
After launch-signoff only, invoke the approved launch workflow. Verify installer, blockmap and latest.yml correspond to the same source commit; confirm clean install and update on isolated devices.

## Start files
scripts/leonidas-release.ts; .github/workflows/team-release.yml; apps/desktop/src/updates

## Dependencies
Complete the V0.30.0 release gate before accepting this milestone. Explicit owner launch approval and launch-signoff are required.

## Done when
- [ ] Approved V1.0 artifacts verified; installed app shows correct history; rollback/recovery instructions work.
- [ ] Report changed files, scoped checks and remaining limitations; preserve unrelated work.

## Verification
Approved V1.0 artifacts verified; installed app shows correct history; rollback/recovery instructions work.

Roadmap key: publish-launch
